description:
OnePlus background process manager. It aggressively kills apps. Despite battery optimization settings it kills Chrome not in use within few seconds; and Tasker can't run long-time jobs.
Removing it will disable the virtual ram expansion feature (swap RAM to disk) and the 'close all' button in the 'recent apps' page.
Keep the app if you worry about battery life. Remove if your apps are killed.
https://xdaforums.com/t/did-anyone-find-a-solution-against-the-agressive-background-killing-of-apps.4491351/post-87421063
